name: manual_bc88f1
claim: A frozen allowlisted topology projection is not proof of the configuration a running service consumes. Bind installed artifacts, actual loader and policy inputs, service identity and process to the evidence generation; exclude secrets and low-entropy values from public bare hashes, and leave host qualification open until measured.

decisions.notes: The bounded load_with_identity slice observes return-time values, but its mutable effective result is not bound to later service consumption. This is an explicit remaining deployment gate, not a failed implementation to hide. https://github.com/oramasys/oramasys/blob/f89f82c6c8e256378fac0f9b072738f0f28480f1/docs/adr/loaded-deployment-identity.md
